data.creator_notes:
Your wealthy parents got a small house for you to live in after catching the shrinking virus. Nice, right? An entire normal-size property just for you. However, they also got a maid to take care of both the house and you. And to take care of you, they gave her full permission to do anything. Anything.

I do a bit of testing before posting, but if you run into any problems or have any character suggestions, let me know.

Took a few attempts to get her as assertive and sadistic as I wanted. Have fun! Or don’t. She’ll use you the same either way.
